<style>
.analytics-hub-hero {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e3a8a 50%, #0369a1 100%);
  color: #ffffff;
  padding: 2.5rem 2rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 30px -8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.35);
  text-align: center;
}

.hub-hero-badge {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.35rem 0.95rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
  border-radius: 9999px;
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  color: #7dd3fc;
}

.hub-hero-title {
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}

.hub-hero-desc {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  color: #e0f2fe;
  max-width: 820px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  line-height: 1.6;
}

/* 3 Main Tool Cards Grid */
.hub-tools-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(320px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 3rem;
}

.hub-tool-card {
  background: #ffffff;
  border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  padding: 1.85rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
  transition: var(--transition);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.hub-tool-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 4px;
}

.card-comparator::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #2563eb, #38bdf8); }
.card-timeline::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #0ea5e9, #10b981); }
.card-engine::before { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #6366f1, #a855f7); }

.hub-tool-card:hover {
  transform: translateY(-5px);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-hover);
  border-color: #93c5fd;
}

.tool-card-icon {
  width: 52px;
  height: 52px;
  border-radius: 12px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  font-size: 1.6rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.icon-blue { background: #eff6ff; color: #2563eb; }
.icon-cyan { background: #ecfeff; color: #0891b2; }
.icon-purple { background: #f5f3ff; color: #7c3aed; }

.tool-card-title {
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #0f172a;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.tool-card-desc {
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  color: #64748b;
  line-height: 1.6;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  flex-grow: 1;
}

.tool-card-features {
  list-style: none;
  padding: 0;
  margin: 0 0 1.5rem 0;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  color: #334155;
}

.tool-card-features li {
  padding: 0.35rem 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}

.tool-card-features li::before {
  content: "✓";
  color: #2563eb;
  font-weight: bold;
}

.tool-card-btn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.92rem;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: var(--transition);
  background: #1e3a8a;
  color: #ffffff;
}

.tool-card-btn:hover {
  background: #2563eb;
  color: #ffffff;
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

/* KPI Banner */
.hub-kpi-banner {
  background: #f8fafc;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr));
  gap: 1.5rem;
  text-align: center;
}

.kpi-item-val {
  font-size: 1.85rem;
  font-weight: 800;
  color: #1e3a8a;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
}

.kpi-item-lbl {
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #64748b;
}
</style>

<div class="hub-tools-grid">

      </p>
      <ul class="tool-card-features">
        <li>16대 핵심 거래소·청산소 데이터 수록</li>

        <li>차이점만 강조(Highlight Differences) 기능</li>
        <li>IT·매매·리스크·청산 분야별 필터링</li>

  <div class="hub-tool-card card-timeline">

      </ul>

      <span>→</span>

  <!-- Tool 3: Engine Benchmark & Architecture -->
  <div class="hub-tool-card card-engine">

        <li>글로벌 4대 CCP Default Waterfall 비교</li>
